items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: Dewey Redman and Don Pullen they were very big mentors to me

ctx.x: I would say, I would give that person my phone number and say have her call me. That’s exactly what I’d do and that’s what I’ve done. Here’s my phone number. Here’s my email. I’d love to talk to your daughter, niece, whoever it is, and encourage them and then

see where they’re coming from. I’ve got a number of young people that call me that are just sort of embarking on maybe, you know, going out there and doing something. But you know unfortunately there’s also a lot of fear of failure and of course everybody — well not everybody because I know people that are fearless, so I’m not fearless. If I’m really, really — what’s the word called — inspired or my vision is so so strong about something I will pursue it. But you know I fear often of failure and I think now that…
Yeah I’m happy to hear that. Because sometimes the same question another musician would be much more not encouraging. “Well you just better be aware that” this and that.
